source_corrections: MathDB says symmetric, while actual primary S(2n,R) consists of nonsingular skew-symmetric forms. The certificate targets that primary-source conjecture.

Printed Def2.12 sums over all permutations without the standard factor 1/(2^m m!). Both raw printed and standard normalized invariant equalities are certified, so this typographical normalization ambiguity does not affect the counterexample.
novelty_scope: Posted counterexample matrices credited to Shivam Patel. Local proof uses a quadratic annihilating-polynomial obstruction instead of computing eigenspace dimensions. No priority or new mathematical discovery claim.
